title: Bangkit Sabahan gathering supporting Hajiji and Musa Aman
reason: Sabah Media reports an actual gathering of approximately 1,500 people at Anjung Selera Likas, but the organizer’s described message opposes the separate Gempur Rasuah demand that the Chief Minister and Governor resign and expresses support for the incumbent government. The opened body does not establish an anti-state or state-policy demand by this gathering.
notes: This event is distinct from the Suara Mahasiswa march at Menara Kinabalu. The attendance figure is the report’s actual estimate and is not added to the student rally. A separate search result’s 30,000 pre-event target is not actual attendance.
